verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents the building blocks an agent would need: real-time webhooks with stable event IDs, delivery status and re-delivery, plus a billing suite of subscriptions and recurring invoices. Agents can reach the account through the AgentOS MCP server and the CLI, and the Developer MCP can simulate events in the sandbox. However, nothing in the pack covers failed-payment events, payment retry controls, or dunning outreach, so an agent would have to assemble this workflow itself. Missing for 10: documented failed-payment and past-due webhook events, a retry or smart-retry API for subscription charges, built-in dunning emails or outreach workflows, an AgentOS skill for collections or dunning, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
